outputs.explanation: The bar chart of cell death (%) reports mean±s.d. of three independent experiments (n=3), but only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points from the three experiments are overlaid.
The bar chart of cell death (%) is shown with error bars indicating averaged data across replicate experiments, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
The grouped bar chart reports mean±s.d. of three experiments at each time point, but only summary bars with error bars are displayed; individual replicate values are not shown.
The bar chart of cell death (%) shows averaged values with error bars across conditions, but no individual data points from the underlying replicates are overlaid.
